categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Modifies src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h, src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, and tests to add btck_witness_stack_to_bytes to the kernel C API.
categories.rationale: Adds a missing convenience and performance serialization function to the kernel C API. The PR addresses the 'O(n²) cost of reading a whole witness with btck_witness_stack_get_item_at' by providing a single-call consensus byte serialization method.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Although labeled Validation, the category explicitly excludes PRs whose primary subject is the kernel library API and do not alter validation logic.
categories.rationale: This PR only adds an export function to the libbitcoinkernel C API and does not alter consensus rules or node validation logic.
